expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: The review says "Line 4: search is a clickable `<div>`... Keyboard users can't tab to it" and "Line 5: icon-only delete button has no accessible name."

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: The review says "Line 6: paste is blocked... Remove the `onPaste` handler" and "Line 5: delete runs at once with no confirmation."

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: The review flags "Line 3: `height: '100vh'` on a fixed bottom bar" with a fix to use `100dvh`, and also "no safe-area inset on a fixed bottom element" with `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.
